patientSafety.heading: Patient Safety

items.title: Medical Grade Sterilization
items.text: We follow a two step process to make our instruments sterile. First the instruments are thoroughly washed to remove any visible debris and air dried.

items.title: CDC Recommended Disinfection
items.text: CDC has divided noncritical surfaces in dental offices into clinical contact and housekeeping surfaces.

items.title: UV Disinfection of Non-Medical Equipment
items.text: UVC radiation has effectively been used for decades to reduce the spread of bacteria, such as tuberculosis.

items.q: How Do I Find a Trusted Dentist in New York?
items.a: Finding a dentist in New York is easy with Zen Dentistry. Our experienced team provides top-tier dental care in a modern and comfortable setting. Book your appointment today for personalized treatment.

items.q: Do You Offer Teeth Whitening in New York?
items.a: Yes! At Zen Dentistry, we provide professional teeth whitening in New York to brighten your smile. Our advanced treatments remove stains and discoloration, giving you a whiter, more confident smile.

items.q: Do Your New York Dentists Treat Dental Emergencies?
items.a: Yes! At Zen Dentistry, we offer prompt and gentle care for dental emergencies. Whether you have a toothache, broken tooth, or other urgent concerns, our skilled dentists are here to help.

items.q: How Often Should I Visit a Dentist in New York?
items.a: For optimal oral health, we recommend visiting Zen Dentistry every six months for a routine exam and cleaning. Regular check-ups help prevent issues and keep your smile healthy and bright.
